title: RequirementsElicitorItems
description: Shape of content.items for L1-requirements-elicitor, nested inside the standard AgentOutput envelope (schemas/agent-output-schema.json). There is no separate requirements document — this agent produces no artifact. Unlike Phase 0's items (short meta-point summaries of long narrative sections), each functional_requirements[].statement is carried in FULL, verbatim — not summarized — because a functional requirement is already atomic (ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 'Singular') and downstream agents (nfr-classifier, prd-composer, story-generator) need the EXACT wording to classify/compose/derive stories from, not a gloss. items IS the sole, authoritative record of the requirement set — not a distillation of something fuller stored elsewhere. compound_splits IS condensed (source_clause_summary), since a compound vision.md clause's full text already lives in vision.md itself, not duplicated here.

compound_splits.description: One entry per vision.md clause that bundled ≥2 independently testable capabilities. Empty array (not omitted) if genuinely none found.

title.description: Short label — not prose, kept in full

statement.description: The full requirement statement, verbatim — carried in full, not condensed. Must state exactly ONE testable capability (ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 Singular) — no 'and'/'or' joining two behaviours; a compound clause is split into separate FRs instead (see compound_splits).

traces_to.description: vision.md section this requirement traces to — every FR MUST trace to exactly one section (ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 Traceable)

notes.description: Present only if this FR resulted from splitting a compound clause — cross-references the compound_splits entry

source_clause_summary.description: Short gloss of the compound vision.md clause — the full clause text is in vision.md itself, not duplicated here

split_into.description: The ≥2 FR ids this clause was split into — a compound clause split into only one FR is a contradiction in terms
